steps.name: Verify identity file exists in data-dir/identities/
Record initial balances on both nodes
POST /v1/transfer from EC2-1 to EC2-2 (5 Lux)
Verify EC2-2 balance increased by ~4.995 (minus 0.1% relay fee)
Get starting balances for EC2-1's peerId from all 3 nodes
Transfer 5 Lux from EC2-1 to EC2-2
Query EC2-1's balance from all 3 nodes
All 3 should show identical decreased balance
Start Node A on port 4200 with fresh data-dir (no bootstrap)
Start Node B on port 4201 with fresh data-dir (no bootstrap)
GET /peers on both — each shows the other
Check proposal status — vote counts, quorum reached
Verify response has: uptime, peers, memory, cpu, ledger, agents, alerts
Start fresh node, wait 2 min, verify same fields (0 agents, empty alerts)
Verify uptime increases on subsequent calls
Check guardrails log for audit trail
Note EC2-1 balance at time T
Check EC2-1 balance — should increase by ~0.05 Lux (or 0.25 with 5x multiplier)
Check emission log for witness signatures
Verify emission fires once per epoch, not more
Wait 30s for peer connections to drop
GET /peers on each of 5 nodes — each shows 3+ peers
GET /network on EC2-1 — verify connected topology
Query EC2-1's balance from all 5 nodes — all identical
At 30s mark: GET /peers — should show 2+ peers
Record starting balances for all 3 peerIds on all 3 nodes
Transfer 5 Lux from EC2-1 to LS-1
Transfer 2 Lux from LS-1 to Windows
Verify all 3 nodes agree on final balances for all 3 accounts
Make transfers on EC2-1 that LS-1 doesn't see
Check LS-1 balances — should match EC2-1 (missed txns reconciled)
Wait for agent to reach WORKING state
Verify agent resumes with same sessionId
Verify EC2-1 capabilities show storageBackend: mongodb
Verify LS-1 capabilities show storageBackend: p2p
POST /v1/threads from LS-1 — proxied to EC2-1
GET messages from EC2-1 — message present
Verify P2P discovery routes to EC2-1
HTTP GET the S3 URL — expect 200 with HTML
SSH EC2-1: pm2 list — app running
SSH EC2-1: pm2 list — app gone
SSH EC2-1: nginx config file deleted
Use same token on EC2-2 — 200 OK (cross-node)
Verify JWT is stateless (no DB lookup on EC2-2)
POST /v1/threads from LS-1 — expect degraded error, not crash
GET /v1/balance on LS-1 — ledger still works
Wait 30s — POST /v1/threads from LS-1 works again
Create thread from LS-1 (routed to EC2-1), note threadId
Create NEW thread from LS-1 — should route to EC2-2
Verify original thread still on EC2-1
Check balance — 5 Lux earned for task completion
GET /v1/resources — new resource appears (key NOT in response)
GET /v1/resources on EC2-1 — resource visible (P2P sync)
POST /v1/search from LS-1 with query and tier=simple
Check response metadata for backend/resource used
Verify LS-1 did NOT access API key directly
POST /v1/content/publish from EC2-1 with title, body, tags
GET /v1/content/<id> on LS-1 — full content retrieved
Verify results include content from BOTH EC2-1 and EC2-2
Trigger credential op from LS-1 (e.g., resource usage)
Verify P2P request sent to EC2-1
Verify LS-1 gets result without seeing raw credential
Send 100 rapid GET /v1/status requests from same IP
Check for 429 Too Many Requests responses
Wait for rate limit window to expire
Wait for epoch — check if emission fires
Verify bootstrap fallback used (not unlimited mint)
Next epoch — verify witness signatures present
